The simple version

From idea to live website in three steps

Build & manage

You (and AI) create and edit everything in the Nifty dashboard — every page sliced into editable blocks.

Publish as static

Your site is compiled into fast, secure, ready-to-serve static pages. No live database to slow it down or attack.

Served from the edge

Delivered from Cloudflare’s global network — hundreds of cities, close to every visitor — for near-instant loads.

props.label: Under the hood
props.html:
For the technical

Under the hood

Enough to satisfy the curious — without giving away the secret sauce.

  • Architecture. Statically-generated pages — no live database on the public site.
  • Hosting / CDN. Cloudflare Pages — a global edge network across hundreds of cities.
  • Security. Free SSL/HTTPS and DDoS protection — no database or plugins to exploit.
  • Spam protection. Cloudflare Turnstile — privacy-friendly and invisible.
  • Form email. SMTP2GO transactional delivery — a dedicated sending account per site, bundled in.
  • Edge logic. A lightweight edge worker handles the dashboard proxy, preview redirect and lead routing.
